scope: R58's eight weak photo candidates and two older-licence holds; no geography or source-ownership changes.
review_method: Commons current imageinfo SHA1, creator and exact CC licence page verified during source download. Visual inspection of all ten real WebPs at original preview and contact-sheet sizes; selected exact buildings and readable mobile compositions; hashed reviewed derivatives committed into local approved assets.

approved.rationale: The cathedral west facade and twin spires fill the frame; correct replacement for statue-detail photograph.
Whole basilica, lawn and exterior pilgrimage grounds clearly visible.
Recognisable brighter interior, Marian altar framed; no misleading claim of a facade view.
Wide complex and identifiable monastery bell tower, better geographic overview than isolated rooftop.
Entire basilica facade and distinctive spire lit at blue hour; recognisable, notwithstanding dusk lighting.
Green-roof Gnadenkapelle exterior matches the chapel described by the Altötting pilgrimage authority.
Recognisable angular roof of the Catholic Martyrs Basilica shown from above; not Anglican site.
Pilgrimage basilica body and tower visible together from the square, in daylight.

held.reason: Photograph shows visitors praying at the tomb but lacks clear architecture and has only 676px original width. Older migrated CC/GFDL source requires an explicit release decision; do not use as the hero image.

Source identifies exact Catholic Slipper Chapel but candidate depicts an interior altar/window rather than the exterior; unsuitable for hero. Source is an older Geograph CC BY-SA 2.0 work; retain photographer attribution and licence if later used.

release_gate: No automatic approval; publication registry contains only eight separately inspected CC BY-SA 4.0 additions. The two older-licence files remain outside the public approved asset tree.
